question: One of the ______, the giant redwood tree Sequoia is one of the tallest tree species.
solution:
The correct answer is __**gymnosperms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The giant tree belonging to the family of **Sequoia** sempervirens is known as Red Wood__.
 
• Sequoia sempervirens are the only living species of the genus Sequoia in the cypress family Cupressaceae.
 
• They are also referred to as redwood, coastal redwood, etc.
 
• It is the tallest, evergreen, and long-lived gymnosperm.
 
• The leaves of gymnosperms are well adapted to extremes of climate.
 
• The height of a plant has reached 377 ft tall with a trunk of 9 m in diameter.
 
• The Sequoia sempervirens are **gymnosperms** since they do not possess flowers.
 
• They are present mainly in the mountains where precipitation from the approaching dampness off the sea is more prominent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

__
 
• Gymnosperm: 

 
 
• The term Gymnosperm comes from the Greek words gymnos meaning "naked" and sperma meaning "seed".
 
• Gymnosperms are non-flowering, seed-bearing plants.
 
• Fruits are not formed due to the lack of floral parts.
 
• Seeds are formed on the inner side of scale-like leaves that are spirally arranged into a cone.
 
 

Explanation:__

__
 
• The endosperm is the primary source of food for the developing embryo.
 
• In gymnosperms, the endosperm is formed before fertilization.
 
• It is formed from the female gametophytic cells and is haploid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mosses from tiny gametophytes are the dominant step of the life cycle. Green, flat structures resembling true leaves, but lacking in vascular tissue, are attached in a spiral to the central stem or seta.
 
• **Pteridophytes **don't produce flowers and seeds hence they reproduce using spores.
 
 
• Pteridophytes are also known as cryptogams.
 
• Ferns and Azolla are some examples of Pteridophytes.
 
 
 
• Liverworts are a group of non-vascular plants similar to mosses.
 
 
• They do not produce seeds, flowers, fruit or wood, and even lack vascular tissue.
 
• Instead of seeds, liverworts produce spores for reproduction.
